data.name: Varsha
data.gender_notes: Varsha is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit varṣā, 'rain', from the root vṛṣ, 'to rain'. Its root is Sanskrit vṛṣ (वृष्). A classical Sanskrit term for rain. Varsha is a Sanskrit name meaning “Rain; monsoon; a year”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Varsha expresses “Rain; monsoon; a year”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit varṣā, 'rain', from the root vṛṣ, 'to rain'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Varsha total 24, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.

vedic_reference.note: Varsha is a name of Goddess Indra's wife, Sachi. She is also known as Indrani. She is the goddess of monsoon, and is considered the giver of prosperity and happiness.

historical_references.reference: A classical Sanskrit term for rain.
